facts.fact: DLA Piper Africa says the Data Center Regulation (Decree 71/2025 of 31 December 2025) comes with "the beginning of the process of drafting the National Digital Transformation Strategy of Mozambique", under a Digital Transformation project spearheaded by INTIC; the note gives no start date, so the as_of is its publication date, 18 February 2026.

note: The note does not describe the strategy's scope, so the fact is recorded with class empty.
